title: Card Relationship Grading Table: The Days Charged on a Certificate of Deposit Penalty
content:
The number of days of interest a penalty on a certificate of the Certificates of Deposit line runs over is graded by the card the owner holds and by how recently it has been used.

## 1. The grades

The days charged are graded: an owner holding an active Travel Rewards Visa Signature or Visa Infinite Private Client card with at least 3 card purchases posted in the three months before the withdrawal is charged three quarters of the days the tier publishes, rounded up to a whole day; an owner holding an active card of any other tier with at least 3 card purchases posted in those three months is charged nine tenths of the days the tier publishes, rounded up to a whole day; every other owner is charged the days the tier publishes.

The cards named are tiers of the bank's Personal Credit Cards line, and the purchases counted are those posted to the owner's active card over the three months ending on the day of the withdrawal.

## 2. The grades as a table

| Active card held | Card purchases posted in those three months | Days charged |
|---|---|---|
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature or Visa Infinite Private Client | 3 or more | three quarters of the days the tier publishes, rounded up to a whole day |
| a card of any other tier | 3 or more | nine tenths of the days the tier publishes, rounded up to a whole day |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature or Visa Infinite Private Client | fewer than 3 | the days the tier publishes |
| a card of any other tier | fewer than 3 | the days the tier publishes |
| none held | any | the days the tier publishes |

The count of 3 is a floor: exactly 3 purchases in the three months satisfies it.

## 3. Rounding the reduced figures

Both reductions are rounded up to a whole day, so a fraction of a day never survives.

| Days the tier publishes | Three quarters of them, rounded up | Nine tenths of them, rounded up |
|---|---|---|
| 90 | 68 | 81 |
| 180 | 135 | 162 |
| 365 | 274 | 329 |

Three quarters of 90 is 67.5, which rounds up to 68; nine tenths of 90 is exactly 81, and a figure already whole is not lifted a further day. Three quarters of 365 is 273.75, rounding up to 274, and nine tenths of 365 is 328.5, rounding up to 329.

## 4. Basis Q&A

**Whose card is looked at?** The owner's own active card. Where the owner holds none, the third grade governs and the days the tier publishes are charged in full.

**Does the size of the purchases matter?** No. It is the number of purchases posted in those three months that is counted, and the figure asked of it is 3.
